svg.title: Zcash address types, decoded
svg.desc: Infographic. Three address types: transparent (t1, public), Sapling (zs1, private) and Unified (u1, pool depends on bundled receivers). A Unified Address bundles Orchard (now paying into Ironwood), Sapling and transparent receivers; the sender uses the first it supports. Shielding and deshielding reveal amounts; shielded to shielded stays private. Four checks before sending.

text.tspan: now pays into the Ironwood pool

svg.text: The sender uses the first receiver it supports (1, then 2, then 3).
Any mix is allowed, with at least one shielded receiver.
There is no separate Ironwood receiver type.

svg.text: Check the prefix: t1/t3, zs1 or u1 (utest1 is testnet).
Compare at least the first 20 characters with theirs.
Confirm the wallet or exchange accepts that address type.
Addresses are safe to share. Never share keys or recovery phrases.
Fictional addresses. Draft ZIP 316 Rev. 2 adds zu1/tu1 prefixes (not live).
Sources: ZIP 316 · ZecHub Wiki · zcash/zips repository · Status: October 2026
